messages.content: Rewrite this one-day trip request the way a real traveller might type it: change the wording and the sentence order, informal is fine. Keep EVERY number, time (exactly as written, 24-hour HH:MM), money amount and place name exactly as written. Do not add, drop or change any requirement. Output only the rewritten request.

I'm free from 09:00 to 14:10. My budget is S$47. I definitely need to see Orchard Road and Flower Dome and Cloud Forest. If there's time, I'd also like Singapore Cable Car and Haw Par Villa. I want to do Orchard Road before Flower Dome and Cloud Forest. I want to be at Orchard Road no earlier than 10:00 and done there by 11:50. I'd like to spend 75 minutes at Singapore Cable Car. I'd like to spend 90 minutes at Flower Dome and Cloud Forest. I want to be at Flower Dome and Cloud Forest no earlier than 11:50 and done there by 14:55.

response:

I definitely want to hit Orchard Road before Flower Dome and Cloud Forest. Specifically, I need to be at Orchard Road no earlier than 10:00 and done there by 11:50.
